name: Counterspell
description:
You attempt to prevent a creature within medium range from casting a spell. If the spell you're attempting to counter includes a skill check, roll Lore vs that skill. Otherwise, roll Lore vs Awareness. On a win, the casting fails and any resources required for the spell are consumed. On a loss, the spell is cast as normal.

Describe how you counter the spell.
successes:
✨: On a loss, you may to make the opposed roll a second time (but not a third time), ill-favored.

🌞: On a win, you may allow the spell to be cast, but with the caster as the target of the spell. On a loss, you may make the opposed roll a second time.

💀: If you're not already the target of the spell, you become the target. Check a condition.
